neighbours.label: ' case' in 'worst case' (also '-off' as in send-off)
fire: Engineers planned for the worst case when designing the dam.
Even in the worst case, the repair should take a week.
Our budget assumes a worst case of ten percent inflation.
Doctors said that in the worst case he would need surgery.
So what happens in the worst case if the server fails?
Pack extra water for the worst case on a desert hike.
Analysts modelled a worst case where prices doubled.
In a worst-case scenario the bridge would have to close.
quiet: Engineers planned for the floods when designing the dam.
Even at worst, the repair should take a week.
Our budget assumes inflation of ten percent this year.
Doctors said that his case was unusual and needed surgery.
So what happens to this case if the judge is ill?
Pack extra water in a hard case on a desert hike.
Analysts reviewed a case study where prices doubled.
During the worst storm of the year the bridge had to close.

notes: Card: top examples are all 'worst case'; '-off' x11. Probe: 'worst case' 1.1, other senses of 'case' ~0, '-off' ~0.17-0.19. Near misses keep 'worst' or 'case' but not the phrase.
